heroSummary: Seattle Public Schools began the 2025–26 school year on Wednesday, September 3, 2025, for students in grades 1–12. Kindergarten and preschool students started Monday, September 8. The last day of school was Wednesday, June 17, 2026, with a one-hour early dismissal.
calendarNotes: The 2025–26 SPS calendar lists elementary parent-teacher conference days, weekly Wednesday early releases except during the first week of school, semester dates, quarter dates, trimester dates, and potential makeup dates on June 18, June 22, and June 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Seattle Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–12 started Wednesday, September 3, 2025. Kindergarten and preschool students started Monday, September 8.

calendarFaqs.q: When was SPS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: SPS Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students returned Monday, January 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When was SPS Spring Break in 2026?
When was the last day of school for SPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school was Wednesday, June 17, 2026, with a one-hour early dismissal.

customSections.label: Opening Dates by Student Group
customSections.content: SPS did not start every student group on the same day in 2025–26. Grades 1–12 started September 3, while kindergarten and preschool families had Family Connections before the September 8 first day.
